name: experience-engine
description: Framework-agnostic runtime for multi-dimensional UI experience transitions, with its React adapter, showcase and research record.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @experience-engine/core && npm run build -w @experience-engine/react
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p 01-runtime --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test:contract && npm test -w experience-engine-studio
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w experience-engine-studio
